2607.18102.title: FinSAgent: Corpus-Aligned Multi-Agent RAG Framework for Evidence-Grounded SEC Filing Question Answering
2607.18102.paper_summary: Financial question answering over U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) filings requires retrieving and synthesizing heterogeneous evidence dispersed across long, standardized, and highly redundant disclosures. Existing retrieval-augmented and multi-agent systems typically derive retrieval queries directly from the user's question and rank candidates by semantic similarity. Together, these choices create prior-corpus misalignment: a mismatch between model priors and the target filings' structure, terminology, and evidence standards. As a result, query generation misses corpus-specific evidence, while semantic reranking favors topically similar but evidentially invalid false-positive chunks. We propose FinSAgent, an evidence-grounded multi-agent framework that reframes SEC filing QA as corpus-aligned retrieval planning and corrects both ends with a single principle: inject corpus-side conditioning wherever model priors would otherwise dominate. FinSAgent combines (1) role-specialized agents anchored to the mandated 10-K item structure, (2) database-aware query decomposition that conditions each agent's sub-queries on a lightweight, summary-level view of the local corpus, and (3) multi-path retrieval with a learned feature-gated reranker that separates evidential validity from semantic similarity. Across five offline financial QA benchmarks, FinSAgent improves retrieval coverage and answer correctness over strong single-agent and multi-agent baselines; in a three-arm randomized online experiment with 1,000 anonymous user ratings, it also receives higher scores than baselines.
2607.18102.paper_summary_zh: 財務問題回答涉及美國證券交易委員會（SEC）檔案，需要檢索和綜合分散在冗長、標準化且高度冗餘的披露中的異質證據。現有的檢索增強和多代理系統通常直接從用戶的問題中導出檢索查詢，並根據語義相似性對候選者進行排名。這些選擇共同造成了先前語料庫的不對齊：模型先驗與目標檔案的結構、術語和證據標準之間的不匹配。因此，查詢生成錯過了特定語料庫的證據，而語義重新排名則偏向主題相似但證據上無效的假陽性片段。我們提出了FinSAgent，一個基於證據的多代理框架，將SEC檔案的QA重新構建為語料庫對齊的檢索規劃，並以一個單一原則修正兩端：在模型先驗可能主導的地方注入語料庫側的條件。FinSAgent結合了（1）專門角色的代理，固定在要求的10-K項目結構上，（2）數據庫感知的查詢分解，根據當地語料庫的輕量級摘要級視圖為每個代理的子查詢提供條件，以及（3）多路徑檢索，配備學習的特徵閘重排器，將證據的有效性與語義相似性分開。在五個離線財務QA基準測試中，FinSAgent在檢索覆蓋率和答案正確性上超越了強大的單代理和多代理基準；在一項包含1,000個匿名用戶評分的三臂隨機在線實驗中，它的得分也高於基準。
